versions.content: Reception parameters derived from meta data items Status: DRAFT If a packet is received, the V2xGn module shall consume meta data items PduIn- foPtr.MetaDataPtr configured at the V2xGnRxPdu that corresponds to the given RxPduId in the following order: • ETHERNET_MAC_64 indicating the Physical source address (MAC address in net- work byte order) • BROADCAST_8 indicating a broadcast frame
